"Course Notice and Risk Warning:

The SPAX running course, including all courses within the SPAX App (hereinafter referred to as "Courses"), is a product developed and operated by SPAX and its affiliates. The ownership and intellectual property rights of the Courses belong to SPAX and its affiliated companies. Exercise carries certain risks, and before starting the Courses, you should take a responsible attitude towards yourself and take reasonable precautions and assess your own capabilities. You should also confirm that you have carefully read and accepted this "Course Notice and Risk Warning".

This notice applies to all SPAX users.

The following groups are not suitable for participating in the Courses: teenagers under 16 years old, elderly people over 60 years old, those who are preparing for pregnancy, pregnant women and mothers within one year of breastfeeding, those who have undergone surgery within 6 months or major surgery within one year, individuals with diabetes, gout, severe metabolic diseases, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, lung diseases, orthopedic injuries, spinal diseases, joint injuries, and other individuals who have been advised by a doctor not to exercise.

Before participating in the Courses, you should go to a medical institution for a physical examination and consult a doctor about your physical condition to ensure that you have the physical condition to participate in the Courses.

Before and after participating in the Courses, please do not consume alcoholic beverages or any stimulants prohibited by national laws and regulations.

If you have any physical conditions that may affect or may be affected during the Courses, or if you feel any discomfort during the Courses, please stop immediately.

If you ignore the above notice but still insist on participating in the Courses, you will bear all risks, damages, and liabilities, and SPAX will not assume any legal responsibility or any compensation or reimbursement arising therefrom.

If you have any questions about equipment use or course content, please carefully read the relevant equipment instructions or course action guidelines to avoid the risk of injury. After participating in the Courses, please start slowly and progress gradually.

Due to differences in personal physique, basic forms, and exercise abilities, SPAX cannot guarantee that all users will achieve a certain desired fitness effect.

Entering the training means that you have fully understood all the risks, damages, and liabilities that may arise from participating in the training courses, and voluntarily assume such risks and liabilities."

translations.th: เปิดใช้งานอุปกรณ์ bluetooth แล้ว กำลังซิงค์ข้อมูล

subItems.sourceText: The bluetooth component is about to enter sleep mode. Please try stepping on the pedal or tapping the screen to keep the Bluetooth enabled. Once the Bluetooth enters sleep mode, it will no longer be able to continue syncing device data
subItems.reviewedSourceText: The bluetooth component is about to enter sleep mode. Step on the pedal or tap the screen to keep Bluetooth enabled. Once Bluetooth enters sleep mode, it can no longer sync device data.

translations.th: ส่วนประกอบ bluetooth กำลังจะเข้าสู่โหมดสลีป เหยียบแป้นหรือแตะหน้าจอเพื่อให้ Bluetooth ทำงานต่อ เมื่อ Bluetooth เข้าสู่โหมดสลีปแล้ว จะไม่สามารถซิงค์ข้อมูลอุปกรณ์ได้
translations.ms: Komponen bluetooth akan memasuki mod tidur. Kayuh pedal atau ketik skrin untuk mengekalkan Bluetooth aktif. Setelah Bluetooth memasuki mod tidur, data peranti tidak lagi dapat disegerakkan.
translations.de: Die bluetooth-Komponente wechselt gleich in den Ruhemodus. Tritt in die Pedale oder tippe auf den Bildschirm, damit Bluetooth aktiviert bleibt. Sobald Bluetooth im Ruhemodus ist, können keine Gerätedaten mehr synchronisiert werden.
translations.tr: bluetooth bileşeni uyku moduna geçmek üzere. Bluetooth bağlantısını etkin tutmak için pedala basın veya ekrana dokunun. Bluetooth uyku moduna geçtiğinde cihaz verileri artık eşitlenemez.
translations.fr: Le composant bluetooth va passer en veille. Pédalez ou touchez l’écran pour maintenir Bluetooth activé. Une fois Bluetooth en veille, les données de l’appareil ne pourront plus être synchronisées.
translations.uk: Компонент bluetooth незабаром перейде в режим сну. Натисніть на педаль або торкніться екрана, щоб Bluetooth залишався активним. Після переходу Bluetooth у режим сну дані пристрою більше не синхронізуватимуться.
translations.ar-SA: مكوّن bluetooth على وشك الدخول في وضع السكون. اضغط على الدواسة أو المس الشاشة لإبقاء Bluetooth مفعّلًا. بعد دخول Bluetooth في وضع السكون، لن يعود بإمكانه مزامنة بيانات الجهاز.
translations.zh: bluetooth 组件即将进入休眠模式。请踩动踏板或点击屏幕以保持 Bluetooth 启用；Bluetooth 进入休眠后将无法继续同步设备数据。
